_meta.immutability_rule: Existing codes MUST NOT change. New codes may only be added in future versions.

HASH_MISMATCH.description: A recomputed hash does not match the stored hash value. Indicates potential tampering or corruption.
HASH_MISMATCH.example_trigger: receipt_hash differs from SHA-256 of the 19 signed fields

CHAIN_BROKEN.description: The hash chain link between consecutive ledger entries is broken. An entry's prev_ledger_hash does not match the previous entry's current_ledger_hash.
CHAIN_BROKEN.example_trigger: ledger entry N prev_ledger_hash != ledger entry N-1 current_ledger_hash

MISSING_FIELD.description: A required field is absent from the receipt or ledger entry. The artifact is structurally invalid.
MISSING_FIELD.example_trigger: receipt is missing receipt_hash or timestamp

INVALID_SIGNATURE.description: The Ed25519 signature on the receipt does not verify against the public key. Indicates forgery or key mismatch.

INVALID_GENESIS.description: The first ledger entry's prev_ledger_hash does not equal SHA-256(b'GENESIS'). The chain has no valid anchor.

INVALID_DECISION.description: The decision field contains a value outside the allowed set: allow, modify, block, escalate.

INVALID_LEDGER_LINK.description: The prev_ledger_hash field is not a well-formed 64-character hex digest.
INVALID_LEDGER_LINK.example_trigger: prev_ledger_hash is 63 characters or contains non-hex characters

ORPHANED_RECEIPT.description: A receipt exists without a corresponding ledger entry. Every receipt must be recorded in the ledger.
ORPHANED_RECEIPT.example_trigger: receipt_hash not found in any ledger entry

ORPHANED_LEDGER_ENTRY.description: A ledger entry exists without a corresponding receipt. Every ledger entry must reference a valid receipt.
ORPHANED_LEDGER_ENTRY.example_trigger: ledger entry receipt_hash does not match any known receipt

REPLAY_DETECTED.description: A previously consumed authorization token or nonce was submitted again. Replay attack detected.
REPLAY_DETECTED.example_trigger: nonce already exists in the nonce registry

TOKEN_EXPIRED.description: The authorization token has exceeded its TTL and is no longer valid.

UNAUTHORIZED.description: An execution or intent submission was attempted without valid authentication.
UNAUTHORIZED.example_trigger: no API key or JWT provided in request

FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH.description: The public_key_fingerprint does not match SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

CHAIN_GAP.description: The ledger contains a gap — entries are missing or out of sequence.
CHAIN_GAP.example_trigger: ledger entry sequence_number skips from 5 to 7
